generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of seeing research that will serve you across the rest of your degree. Every module leans on studies you can learn to read, your own project will ask for a study you shape and carry out, and the habit of asking a focused question and answering it with evidence is what the work rewards. Read research as inquiry, shape your own questions with care, and let the structure carry your reader, and your work will be stronger for it.

That same judgement travels with you after you graduate. Wherever you are asked to find something out and answer for it, the people whose answers are trusted are the ones who gather evidence in a planned way and reason from it honestly. The research habit you have started to build is one you will keep using for a long time.
